hook: THEY SAY ONLY THEY'RE RIGHT|AND THEY'RE NOT WRONG

voices.name: l00
voices.text: Some people say <#0.2#> only their way is right.
voices.caption: Some people say only their way is right.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: We all live in a world <#0.2#> where what we believe becomes the answer.
voices.caption: We all live in a world where what we believe becomes the answer.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: In their world, <#0.2#> it is the answer.
voices.caption: In their world, it is the answer.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: But in someone else's world, <#0.2#> it isn't whole.
voices.caption: But in someone else's world, it isn't whole.
